## Documentation

In-scope changes (public API, CLI, CIF/I-O contracts, crystallographic
invariants, architecture, or how-to-use flows) update stable docs in this
pull request: `docs/api.md`, `docs/cli.md`, `docs/architecture.md`,
`docs/bonds.md`, `docs/tutorials.md`, or a focused design note. Missing docs
on an in-scope pull request is review P1. See `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

When no stable-doc update is required, copy the declaration below onto its
own line, outside this fence and outside HTML comments, and add a one-line
reason. Text left inside the fence does not count.

```
Docs: N/A — one-line reason
```

- Docs paths touched:
- Public API / CLI / CIF-I/O contracts / crystallographic invariants changed (yes/no):
- Agent guide (`AGENTS.md`) updated if a standing rule changed (yes/no):
- [ ] Project-agnostic: no internal project names, private paths, or unpublished data or CIF files
